name: callout
title: Callout
description: Adds a contextual note to running copy. 1px frame, square corners, no accent bar.
docs: Vlak leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/vlak-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

vlak.snippet: Fixed fee. The number on the cover is the number on the invoice.
vlak.example:
import { Callout } from "@noorddev/vlak-react";

Fixed fee. The number on the cover is the number on the invoice.

use: A note inside running copy that deserves a frame: a term, a caveat, a definition.
A bold lead-in and one or two sentences.

a11y: A plain <div> in the reading order; add role="note" and an aria-label when it should be announced as an aside.
